subject: Proposed VP/CIO attendance window — Taproot Systems demo (slot confirmation pending)
messages:
From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@taproot.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VP/CIO presence for Taproot Systems demo next week

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking our call today — were excited to see Redwood in action. For the next-stage demo with our executive sponsors, the ask from Taproot leadership is that a VP-level or CIO-level representative from Redwood join (20-30 minutes of the session) for a short executive overview and Q&A. That helps our board-level stakeholders have direct alignment.

High-level:
- Ideal outcome: exec-level confirmation on fit for our enterprise latency/throughput story and any compliance blockers.
- Proposed demo length: 60 minutes with a 20–30 minute exec segment at the top.

Two windows that work for our execs:
- Tue, Jul 18 — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed, Jul 19 — 15:00–16:00 PT

If neither of those is possible for a VP/CIO, would a short 30-minute handshake with a VP+technical lead be possible the morning of Jul 20? Were somewhat constrained by travel the following week.

Attached: Taproot-Priorities.pdf (short doc on priorities & success criteria).

Can you confirm availability or propose an alternate window by EOD Jul 11?

Thanks,
Liam ONeal
Senior Program Manager, Taproot Systems
liam.oneal@taproot.com
(415) 555-0128

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@taproot.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: VP/CIO presence for Taproot Systems demo next week

Hi Liam — great to hear from you and thanks for the priorities doc.

We can absolutely prioritize an exec segment. Our typical pattern is a 20-minute executive overview followed by a technical deep-dive (40 minutes). To make sure we land the right attendee, two notes:

1) VP/CIO windows are tight next week. I can offer these options from our side:
   - Thu, Jul 18 — 08:30–09:15 PT (short, exec-first handshake then tech follows with senior SE)
   - Fri, Jul 20 — 11:00–12:00 PT (full 60-minute run with reserved exec segment)

2) Ben (AE) will confirm VP-level attendance; if the VP is unavailable well provide a VP-deputy + our Head of Solutions (Marissa) for the exec portion.

To keep this efficient: can you confirm which of your two original slots (Jul 18 or Jul 19) is preferred, or confirm the Friday Jul 20 option above? If Friday is preferable we can lock it now and circulate the calendar invite.

Im attaching a short Redwood-exec-demo-playbook that outlines the 20-minute exec agenda we suggest. Also looping in Ben and Marissa for logistics and the rehearsal.

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Attachments: Redwood-exec-demo-playbook.pdf (guide)

Subject: [Internal] Taproot — exec coverage plan and rehearsal

Ben / Marissa — quick internal note to coordinate before I reply to Liam.

Ask: Taproot wants VP/CIO for a 20–30 minute exec segment. They gave two windows; I offered a couple alternates including Fri Jul 20 (11:00–12:00 PT). Please action below:

- Ben: can you escalate to the VP and get a hard yes/no by EOD Thu Jul 14? If the VP cant make it, confirm the deputy (SVP or Head of Infra) who can cover the 20-minute exec portion. Also confirm whether VP will join live or via phone.
- Marissa: once Ben confirms, can you draft a short 3-slide exec deck (value drivers, security snapshot, ask) and run a 30-min rehearsal on Thu Jul 19 09:00–09:30 PT? Assume we need a short compliance blurb re: data residency — Ill pull the SOC-2 note if needed.

Fallbacks: if we cant get VP, plan for a 15-minute exec handshake + extended time for SE detail; make the agenda flexible.

Thanks — Sofia
(Sent from inbox — internal coordination)

Hi Liam — thanks, weve confirmed a slot and are locking the calendar.

Confirmed: Fri, Jul 20 — 11:00–12:00 PT (60 minutes). Were reserving the first 20 minutes for an executive overview and Q&A. Redwood attendees confirmed so far: Ben Carter (Account Exec), Marissa Cole (Head of Solutions), and myself (Sr. Solutions Engineer). Ben is escalating VP attendance and will confirm whether the VP will join live or provide a short pre-recorded note by EOD Thu Jul 14.

Next steps from our side: 
- I attached the proposed demo agenda for your review (Taproot-demo-agenda.docx). Please highlight any must-see integrations or compliance topics you want in the exec segment.
- Marissa will run a 30-minute rehearsal (Thu Jul 19 09:00–09:30 PT) — well send the invite to your team.
- Ben will follow up on VP attendance and provide the final exec name if confirmed.

Meeting link / calendar invite will follow once Ben confirms the attendee list (were keeping the time reserved).

Looking forward to it — appreciate the flexibility.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
